Meta.title: Aplica
Meta.description: Paste a job posting, get a resume and cover letter in your real voice.

Home.deck: Paste a job posting and get a resume and cover letter in your real voice.
Home.heroAlt: A hand writing by lamplight on the page of an open notebook, on a wooden desk beside a stack of papers.
Home.motifHuman: Closed fourteen enterprise deals in a market where the team had closed three the year before.

argument.title: Your CV already has the better sentence in it.

writes.title: It starts from your words, not a template.
writes.body: Aplica reads your CV once and keeps the sentences you actually wrote. Every line in a draft has to trace back to something already in there. If it can’t, the line doesn’t ship.
writes.fragmentCaption: The opening of a resume Aplica wrote in a real run, shown cropped.

refuses.title: It will tell you to skip a job.
refuses.verdict: A reporting analyst applying to a senior iOS role. Nothing in the CV covers the stack.

image.alt: Someone at a kitchen table late at night, under a single lamp, working through a spread of printed job postings.

costs.title: Your own key, your own words.
costs.body: You bring an API key from Anthropic, OpenAI or Google and pay them directly, in cents. Aplica is free to use and free to host yourself, in English and Spanish.

closing.title: Start with the CV you already have.

Motif.slop: Results-driven professional with a proven track record of success.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Pick up where you left off.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.lead: An email and a password. Your CV and your model key come after.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: If that address needs a link, it’s on its way. Open it in this browser and you’ll land back here signed in.
checkEmail.hint: Nothing yet? Give it a minute, then look in spam.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.lead: Type your email and we’ll send you a link to set a new one.

newPassword.title: Set a new password
newPassword.lead: This replaces the old one everywhere.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don’t match an account.
errors.emailTaken: That address already has an account. Sign in instead.
errors.rateLimited: That was a lot of tries. Wait a minute and go again.
errors.link: That link didn’t work. It may have expired, so ask for a new one.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.

Account.title: Your account
Account.lead: Where your key lives, what language you get, and how to leave.

key.title: Your model key
key.body: Aplica runs on your own provider key, so you pay the model directly and we never mark it up. It is encrypted before it reaches the database, and it is never shown again after you save it.
key.label: API key
key.hint: We check it works before we store it.
key.replace: Pasting a new one replaces it.
key.none: No key yet. Paste one and you can generate an application.

endpoint.label: Endpoint URL
endpoint.hint: An OpenAI-shaped host: NVIDIA NIM, Ollama, OpenRouter, vLLM, or anything else that speaks the same API. Public and https only.

model.label: Model name
model.hint: Only the host knows what it serves, so this is the one provider where you tell us. You can use a different model per application later.

errors.rejected: That key didn’t work. Check you copied all of it, and that it belongs to {provider}.
errors.unreachable: We couldn’t reach {provider} to check the key. Try again in a minute.
errors.invalid_endpoint: That address isn’t allowed. Use a public https URL, not a local or private one.
errors.invalid_model: That doesn’t look like a model name.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong on our side. Your key was not saved.

language.title: Language
language.body: This changes the app. It does not change the language your applications are written in.

session.title: Signed in
session.body: Signing out leaves everything where it is. Your key, your CV and your applications are all still here when you come back.

danger.title: Delete your account
danger.body: This removes your profile, your parsed CV, the file you uploaded, every application you generated, and your encrypted key. It cannot be undone.
danger.confirmHint: This is the last step. There is no undo after it.
danger.mismatch: That does not match your email address.
danger.failed: Something went wrong, so your account is still here. Try again.

language.title: Let’s set a few things up
language.lead: Three short steps, and you can skip any of them. None of this is required just to look around.

name.label: Your name
name.placeholder: As it should appear on your documents
name.hint: This goes on your resume and cover letter. Add it now, or skip it and paste it in later.

language.error: Something went wrong on our side. Your name was not saved.

key.title: Add your model key
key.lead: This is what writes your applications, at your own provider’s rates. You keep the key; we only check that it works before we store it.

voice.title: Which sounds more like you?
voice.lead: Both of these lines are pulled straight from your own CV. Pick whichever one feels more like something you’d actually say, just so you can see we write from your real words, not a generic voice.
voice.error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.

Applications.title: Your applications
Applications.lead: Every run you have generated, newest first.

empty.body: Run your first one and it will show up here.
empty.motifHuman: Took the support queue from a two-day wait to same day, and held it there for a year.

Apply.title: Apply to a job
Apply.lead: Paste the posting. We will tailor your resume to it, tell you honestly whether it is worth sending, and let you download it either way.

posting.label: The job posting
posting.hint: The text of the posting, not a link to it.

postingUrl.label: Or paste a link to it
postingUrl.hint: We’ll try to read the posting from the link. Some sites, like LinkedIn and Workday, block this, and if that happens, paste the text above instead.

model.label: Model
model.hint: Defaults to the one set in your account. Change it here for just this application.
model.ceiling: Response times vary a lot by host, from a few seconds to a couple of minutes.

standard.title: Standard
standard.description: Resume and cover letter, as PDFs.

full.title: Full
full.description: Resume and cover letter, as PDF and Word.

cost.anthropic: Anthropic charges $10 per 1,000 searches for this, on top of tokens.
cost.google: Google charges $14 per 1,000 requests for this, on top of tokens. The first 5,000 each month are free.

Cv.title: Your CV
Cv.lead: Upload it once. Everything else is built from what is actually in it. Nothing goes to an employer directly.

empty.body: PDF or Word, up to 10 MB.

errors.unauthorized: Your session ran out. Sign in and try again.
errors.bad_request: That did not come through as a file. Choose it again.
errors.key_missing: You need a model key before you can parse a CV. Add one in your account.
errors.model_missing: Your account has no model name saved. Add one in your account.
errors.empty: That file is empty. Upload the CV itself, not a shortcut to it.
errors.too_large: That file is larger than 10 MB. A CV that big is usually a scan; export it from a word processor as a PDF instead.
errors.unsupported_type: That file is not a PDF or a Word .docx, whatever its name says. Export the CV as one of those and upload it again.
errors.legacy_or_encrypted_office: That looks like an old .doc file, or a Word file with a password on it. Save it as .docx without a password, or export it as a PDF.
errors.encrypted_pdf: That PDF has a password on it. Open it, export an unprotected copy, and upload that.
errors.corrupt: That file claims to be a PDF or a .docx but cannot be read. It was probably truncated on the way here. Try uploading it again, or export a fresh copy.
errors.no_text_layer: No text could be read from that file. It is almost certainly a scan or a photo, which has no text layer for us to read. Upload a PDF exported from a word processor.
errors.rate_limited: That is {limit} CV parses today, which is the daily limit. It resets at midnight UTC.
errors.parse_invalid: The model returned something we could not use. Try again.
errors.parse_timeout: That took longer than we could wait for. Nothing was saved, and today's parse count was not spent twice. Try again when you can.

errors.provider_refused: Your provider refused the request. Try again, and check your key in your account if it keeps happening.
errors.provider_unavailable: Your provider is having trouble. Nothing is wrong with your key. Try again shortly.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
errors.streamInterrupted: We lost the connection before hearing back. Wait a moment, then try again.

done.heading: Your profile is ready
done.clean: Every claim matched your own words, so nothing needed softening.

grounding.title: What we checked
grounding.why: A claim only stays sharp if your CV backs it up. This is what did not, and what we did about it.
grounding.softenedBody: The CV does not contain {what}, so this claim is marked as less certain rather than dropped.
grounding.droppedTitle: Not used, in your own words
grounding.droppedBody: Not an exact quote from your CV, so it was left out rather than paraphrased:

notFound.title: That page is not here.
notFound.body: The address is wrong, or whatever used to be at it has moved. Nothing on your side is broken, and nothing you were working on was lost.

server.title: Something broke on our side.
server.body: You did not cause this and nothing you had saved was touched. Try again; if it keeps happening, leave it a few minutes and come back.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.lead: What happens to your CV and your model key, before you hand over either.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Your email to sign you in, the CV file you upload and the profile we parse from it, and the API key for whichever model provider you connect.

why.title: Why
why.body: To turn a job posting you paste in into a resume and cover letter tailored to it, in your own voice.

key.title: Your model key
key.body: It is encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM, using a key held in a server-side secret, not in the database next to it. It is used only on the server, to call the provider you chose, and it is never sent back to your browser, logged, or put in an error message, and it is never shown again after you save it. Delete it any time, one click, in your account.

cv.title: Your CV
cv.body: We parse it once into a structured profile and draw from that from then on. The file and the profile stay yours: nothing from it is ever sent to an employer or anywhere outside this product.

delete.title: Deleting your account
delete.body: Removes your profile, the parsed CV, the file you uploaded, every application you generated, and your encrypted key. There is no soft delete: once it runs, it is gone.

Terms.title: Terms
Terms.lead: The plain-language version, for a product with no lawyers and no billing yet.

byoKey.title: Bring your own key
byoKey.body: Aplica does not charge for generation. You connect your own model provider account, and you pay that provider directly, at their rates. That relationship, and that spend, is between you and them.

openSource.title: Open source engine
openSource.body: The engine that writes your applications is MIT licensed. You can read exactly what it does with your CV and your key, or self-host it yourself.

warranty.title: No warranty
warranty.body: This is provided as is, with no warranty of any kind. We work to keep it honest and accurate, but you are the one sending your application, so review it before you do.

v1.title: A v1 product
v1.body: There is no billing yet. If that changes, it will be a clear, separate decision you can see coming, never a silent change to what you already agreed to.

Styleguide.title: The design system
Styleguide.intro: Every value this product is allowed to use, shown doing its real job on the real paper. If a screen needs something that is not here, the system is wrong, not the screen.

color.green-soft: Text at 20px and up, icons, graphics
color.human: The motif and the result reveal, nothing else

pairs.body: Body text sits here, at full ink.
pairs.secondary: Secondary text carries the quieter half of a screen.
pairs.greenSoft: Green at twenty pixels and up
pairs.note: Judged on the surface it actually lands on, never on white.

type.sample: Paste the posting, keep your voice

motion.easing: One easing family: a soft spring with high damping. Nothing bounces, nothing spins, nothing scales up from zero. Reduced motion swaps all of it for instant states.

button.note: One green action per screen. Everything else is an outline or plain text.
